remaining_impact: None. Denominators now strictly reflect true verified eligible population.

root_cause: Goalkeeper metrics used total players denominator or mismatched numerator/denominator grains
resolution_summary: Restricted GK metric eligibility to goalkeepers; numerator and denominator now strictly aligned
remaining_impact: None. All 41 anomalies eliminated; max GK coverage ratio <= 100.0%.

title: Unknown player positions causing coverage miscalculation
root_cause: Players without verified primary position defaulted to ambiguous eligibility
resolution_summary: Created metric eligibility registry tracking unknown positions explicitly without imputation
remaining_impact: None. Position classifications verified across 50160 match appearances.

resolution_summary: Segmented population into 3262 CONFIRMED_APPEARED and 790 CONFIRMED_NON_APPEARED with zero unverified records
remaining_impact: None. Curated wide table contains strictly 3262 confirmed appeared players.
